mapper.select: SELECT R.REVIEW_NO AS reviewNo, 'CONTENT' AS reviewType, R.CONTENT_NO AS targetNo, C.TITLE AS title, C.POSTER_PATH AS thumbnail, R.RATING AS rating, R.REVIEW_TEXT AS content, R.CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM REVIEW R JOIN CONTENT C ON C.CONTENT_NO = R.CONTENT_NO WHERE R.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND R.STATUS != 'DELETED' ORDER BY R.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT PR.REVIEW_NO AS reviewNo, 'PRODUCT' AS reviewType, PR.PRODUCT_NO AS targetNo, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS title, ( SELECT PI.IMAGE_PATH FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE PI WHERE PI.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO AND PI.IS_MAIN = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS thumbnail, PR.RATING AS rating, PR.CONTENT AS content, PR.CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM PRODUCT_REVIEW PR JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_NO = PR.PRODUCT_NO WHERE PR.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} ORDER BY PR.CREATED_AT DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REVIEW WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND STATUS != 'DELETED'
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO REVIEW ( REVIEW_NO, MEMBER_NO, CONTENT_NO, RATING, REVIEW_TEXT,
SPOILER_YN, STATUS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_REVIEW_NO.NEXTVAL, #{memberNo}, #{contentNo}, #{rating}, #{reviewText},
#{spoilerYn}, 'ACTIVE', SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT REVIEW_NO AS reviewNo, MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, CONTENT_NO AS contentNo, RATING AS rating, REVIEW_TEXT AS reviewText, SPOILER_YN AS spoilerYn, STATUS AS status, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM REVIEW WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND CONTENT_NO = #{contentNo} AND STATUS != 'DELETED'

SELECT REVIEW_NO AS reviewNo, MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, CONTENT_NO AS contentNo, RATING AS rating, REVIEW_TEXT AS reviewText, SPOILER_YN AS spoilerYn, STATUS AS status, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM REVIEW WHERE REVIEW_NO = #{reviewNo} AND STATUS != 'DELETED'
mapper.update:
UPDATE REVIEW SET RATING = #{rating}, REVIEW_TEXT = #{reviewText},
SPOILER_YN = #{spoilerYn}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE REVIEW_NO = #{reviewNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PRODUCT_REVIEW ( REVIEW_NO, PRODUCT_NO, ORDER_ITEM_NO, MEMBER_NO, RATING, CONTENT, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_PRODUCT_REVIEW_NO.NEXTVAL, #{productNo}, #{orderItemNo}, #{memberNo}, #{rating}, #{content}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDER_ITEM OI
INNER JOIN ORDERS O ON O.ORDER_NO = OI.ORDER_NO
WHERE OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO = #{orderItemNo} AND OI.PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo} AND O.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND O.ORDER_STATUS = 'PAID' AND OI.STATUS = 'PAID'
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PAYMENT PM WHERE PM.ORDER_NO = O.ORDER_NO AND PM.PAYMENT_STATUS = 'PAID' )

SELECT REVIEW_NO AS reviewNo, PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, ORDER_ITEM_NO AS orderItemNo, MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, RATING AS rating, CONTENT AS content, CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM PRODUCT_REVIEW WHERE ORDER_ITEM_NO = #{orderItemNo}

SELECT R.REVIEW_NO AS reviewNo, R.MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, M.NICKNAME AS writer, R.RATING AS rating, R.REVIEW_TEXT AS reviewText, R.SPOILER_YN AS spoilerYn, R.STATUS AS status, R.CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM REVIEW R JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = R.MEMBER_NO WHERE R.CONTENT_NO = #{contentNo} AND R.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY R.CREATED_AT DESC
SELECT ROUND(AVG(RATING), 1) FROM REVIEW WHERE CONTENT_NO = #{contentNo} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REVIEW WHERE CONTENT_NO = #{contentNo} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT CONTENT_REVIEW_NO FROM REVIEW_REPORT WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND REVIEW_TYPE = 'CONTENT'
mapper.update: UPDATE REVIEW SET STATUS = 'DELETED', UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE REVIEW_NO = #{reviewNo}
mapper.select: SELECT REVIEW_NO AS reviewNo, PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, ORDER_ITEM_NO AS orderItemNo, MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, RATING AS rating, CONTENT AS content, CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM PRODUCT_REVIEW WHERE REVIEW_NO = #{reviewNo}

SELECT REVIEW_NO AS reviewNo, MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, CONTENT_NO AS contentNo, RATING AS rating, REVIEW_TEXT AS reviewText, SPOILER_YN AS spoilerYn, STATUS AS status, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM REVIEW WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND CONTENT_NO = #{contentNo}
mapper.update:
UPDATE REVIEW SET RATING = #{rating}, REVIEW_TEXT = #{reviewText},
SPOILER_YN = #{spoilerYn}, STATUS = 'ACTIVE', CREATED_AT = SYSDATE, UPDATED_AT = NULL WHERE REVIEW_NO = #{reviewNo}
mapper.select:
SELECT PR.REVIEW_NO AS reviewNo, PR.PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, PR.ORDER_ITEM_NO AS orderItemNo, PR.MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, PR.RATING AS rating, PR.CONTENT AS content, PR.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(M.NICKNAME), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(M.MEMBER_NAME), ''), M.MEMBER_ID ) AS writer, M.PROFILE_IMAGE AS profileImage FROM PRODUCT_REVIEW PR
INNER JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = PR.MEMBER_NO
WHERE PR.PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo}
ORDER BY PR.CREATED_AT DESC, PR.REVIEW_NO DESC
